title: At the speed of light by IA
genre: High-energy Japanese-style electronic dance track with a tempo of 175 BPM in the key of G# minor. The arrangement features a prominent, bright synthesizer lead playing a fast, syncopated melody characterized by rapid arpeggios and wide interval jumps. The rhythm section is driven by a heavy four-on-the-floor kick drum, a sharp snare on the backbeat, and consistent 16th-note hi-hat patterns. A thick, pulsing sawtooth bassline provides the foundation, while occasional vocal samples and digital sound effects add texture. The structure follows a standard electronic format with a build-up leading into a high-intensity drop where the synth melody becomes more complex. Production is polished with heavy sidechain compression on the pads and bass, creating a pumping effect, and a wide stereo field for the lead synths.
